cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.31)
project(NicoHeaderTokenControl LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
configure_file(generated.h.in generated/generated.h @ONLY)
foreach(mode IN ITEMS 1 2)
  add_library(context_${mode} OBJECT main.cpp)
  target_compile_definitions(context_${mode} PRIVATE MODE=${mode})
  target_include_directories(context_${mode} PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
endforeach()
add_library(logical_alias OBJECT alias.cpp)
target_include_directories(logical_alias PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
